# Release notes

The newest release is first. In Odoo the version number starts with the Odoo version, so release 1.1.0 for Odoo 20.0 shows as `20.0.1.1.0`.

## Storage Manager 1.6.2 (Odoo 17.0)

*2026-10-23, Odoo 17.0*

- App description update only. No change to how the app works.

## Storage Manager 1.6.1, Storage Analyzer 1.0.2

*2026-10-22, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- Storage Manager: fixed a crash when moving files between connections.
- Storage Analyzer: app description update only.

## Storage Manager 1.6.0, Storage Analyzer 1.0.0

*2026-10-22, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- First release on the Odoo Apps Store.
